verdict.rationale: Publishing downloadable tax forms and instructions is a fair question for a state tax agency, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains only two probes recording HTTP 403 edge denials to an automated agent. Neither says anything about whether forms or instructions can be downloaded without an account, so there is no affirmative evidence the product delivers this story.

support.subject: As a founder, the forms themselves and their instructions are downloadable from the service's site without an account
